scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && install-electron && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/electron-vite/bin/electron-vite.js dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build
scripts.build:development: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-development
scripts.build:test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-test
scripts.build:distribution: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-distribution
scripts.build:preview: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode mvp-preview
scripts.build:win:development: pnpm run build:development && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.development.ts --publish never
scripts.build:win:test:portable: pnpm run build:test && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config electron-builder.test-channel.ts --publish never
scripts.build:win:portable: pnpm run build:distribution && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
